name: BushBaseCoralFactory
caption: A white base mesh 3D model of a bush-type branching coral. The object displays the raw geometric skeleton of a bush coral — multiple thick branches radiate outward from a central junction point, extending in various directions with a complex, low-lying spread. Rendered without any material color or texture, the pure white geometry reveals the branching topology and the irregular organic silhouette, with a sharp shadow beneath highlighting the structure against the white background.
